exposure: prior history of spontaneous vaginal delivery
prior history of successful vaginal birth after previous cesarean section
outcome: successful vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 409 women who had one previous caesarean section and underwent a trial of labor at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital.
finding: The study found a low prevalence (38.2%) of successful VBAC, with factors such as prior history of spontaneous vaginal delivery, prior successful VBAC, no history of stillbirth, cervical dilation on admission >= 3 cm, fetal station on admission >= 0, and antenatal care follow-up significantly associated with success.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at the time of women's admission for or during their trial of labor.
